scope: iOS output observability only; no Bash/Node/native execution or failure fix established
apply: Apply three exact unique before→after replacements in order; reverse after→before replacements in reverse order requiring uniqueness

edits.before:
xcodebuild -workspace "$workspace" -scheme "$scheme" \
            -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/nyc-tron-ios-derived" \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build | tee /tmp/xcodebuild.log
          test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -eq 0
edits.after:
nyc_tron_ios_output="$NYC_TRON_CONSUMER/ios-command-output"
          if mkdir -p "$nyc_tron_ios_output"; then
            if xcodebuild -workspace "$workspace" -scheme "$scheme" \
              -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator \
              -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/nyc-tron-ios-derived" \
              -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
              CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build > /tmp/xcodebuild.log 2> "$nyc_tron_ios_output/build-stderr.log"; then
              nyc_tron_build_status=0
            else
              nyc_tron_build_status=$?
            fi
          else
            nyc_tron_build_status=$?
            printf '%s\n' 'iOS build output capture setup failed before command execution.' >&2 || :
          fi
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tooling/native/report-ios-command-output.mjs" build "$nyc_tron_build_status" "$NYC_TRON_CONSUMER" || :
          test "$nyc_tron_build_status" -eq 0

nyc_tron_ios_output="$NYC_TRON_CONSUMER/ios-command-output"
          if mkdir -p "$nyc_tron_ios_output"; then
            if node tooling/native/run-ui-acceptance.mjs ios "$app" "$NYC_TRON_CONSUMER" > "$nyc_tron_ios_output/ui-stdout.log" 2> "$nyc_tron_ios_output/ui-stderr.log"; then
              nyc_tron_ui_status=0
            else
              nyc_tron_ui_status=$?
            fi
          else
            nyc_tron_ui_status=$?
            printf '%s\n' 'iOS UI output capture setup failed before command execution.' >&2 || :
          fi
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tooling/native/report-ios-command-output.mjs" ui "$nyc_tron_ui_status" "$NYC_TRON_CONSUMER" || :
          exit "$nyc_tron_ui_status"

build.interpretation: Reporter receives command/redirection/setup shell status; the step retains the original effective0/1 xcodebuild-status test. A nonzero value does not independently establish that xcodebuild launched.

ui.interpretation: Reporter receives command/redirection/setup shell status; exact saved UI status determines step exit. A nonzero value does not independently establish that Node launched.

commandContract.setup: Only mkdir -p of the fixed sibling folder; no runtime-ui-ios creation. Failed setup prints a fixed marker, preserves its failure status and does not run the native command. No fallback or retry.
commandContract.reporting: Reporter is called once after the attempted command/setup settles and shell redirections close; || : makes a reporter failure secondary. Fixed capture files may be absent or partial. Existing files/status alone do not establish execution or complete/fresh command output.
commandContract.upload: One new sibling directory in the existing always() iOS evidence upload; existing /tmp/xcodebuild.log and runtime-ui-ios paths remain.

preserved: All original xcodebuild option/argument tokens, workspace/scheme discovery, working directory and environment
Original node run-ui-acceptance command arguments exactly once, launcher/driver/security/assertions/deadlines/retry logic unchanged
All triggers, runner choice, source/Android steps, other iOS steps and original artifact paths
Build step0/1 normalization distinct from raw saved command status; UI exact saved status
No ZIP extraction, local/alternate execution, workflow dispatch, rerun, ref or PR changes

runUiSource.inspection: Source uses exclusive mkdirSync(runtime-ui-ios), internal UTF-8-decoded stdout+stderr concatenation for subprocess logs, original first-error throw and cleanup; none modified. Raw top-level captured streams must be distinguished from these existing decoded nested logs.

testDiscovery.interpretation: Static source confirms root pnpm test routes through tooling/run-tests.mjs and discoverTests() recursively includes tooling/tests/*.test.mjs. No extra native-workflow source step is added; actual new-test execution remains CI pending.

verification: Exact forward/inverse and source/token/status-model checks only; no YAML/Bash/Node filesystem/macOS runtime execution claimed.
